summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for CUSTOM Criteria; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] It is recommended to check the query execution plan to ensure the query is efficient when using $expr in custom criteria. Sources: https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-custom-criteria-with-isodate/163895

[low] The criteria field is conditional and not required when the type is equal to CUSTOM. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/internal/service/onlinearchive/resource.go

[high] For DATE criteria, when the current date exceeds the specified date field value, Atlas subtracts the number of days from the current time and archives data after that time. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/overview.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[medium] Online Archive requires Custom Criteria to be formatted in strict JSON, meaning functions like ISODate or Date cannot be used directly in date comparisons. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOSH-1849, https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-custom-criteria-with-isodate/163895

[low] Custom criteria that use the $expr workaround (for example on _id) will likely not use an index, making the archival process slow. Sources: https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-using-id/277894

[low] You cannot change the archiving criteria from Date Match to Custom Filter, or vice versa, once the online archive is created. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/manage-online-archive.md

[high] You cannot pass an empty document {} to the custom query to return all documents. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/manage-online-archive.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[low] The recommendation for optimizing archiving speed is to create a new indexed date field rather than using custom criteria with $expr and _id. Sources: https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-using-id/277894

[high] For CUSTOM criteria, Atlas uses the specified query with the db.collection.find(query) command, and custom queries do not support JavaScript expressions. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/manage-online-archive.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/
[low] The strict JSON representation of dates required for Online Archive Custom Criteria is not currently supported by mongosh. Sources: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOSH-1849

[medium] You can incorporate the $expr operator as a workaround in custom criteria of Online Archive, but Atlas might convert a value before evaluating it against the query. Sources: https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-using-id/277894, https://mongodb.com/community/forums/t/online-archive-custom-criteria-with-isodate/163895

[high] There are two types of archiving criteria: DATE, which selects documents based on a date, and CUSTOM, which selects documents based on a custom JSON query. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/docs/resources/online_archive.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/master/internal/service/onlinearchive/resource.go, https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/

[low] The sequence in which MongoDB Cloud slices collection data to create partitions starts with zero, and the criteria.dateField parameter defaults as the first item in the partition sequence. Sources: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/onlinearchive/
